links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated adenomyosis patient information versus recommended public reading level
links.effect: ARI 11.32 (DeepSeek) vs 14.56 (ChatGPT); FRES 46 vs 27; GFI 12.47 vs 14.16; both models at undergraduate reading level, above recommended level for the public.
links.quote: Notably, the readability scores for both models indicated reading levels equivalent to undergraduate education, which is above the recommended level for general public health information.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) on readability and quality for patient health queries regarding adenomyosis, but tests standard model outputs without comparing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
